newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL CENTRAL BANK LOWERS MINI-BAND ON REAL.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL CENTRAL BANK LOWERS MINI-BAND ON REAL.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank lowered its mini-band on the real currency by buying dollars at 1.0850 and selling at 1.0900 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set at between 1.0840 and 1.0890 reais per dollar.
Thursday's auction was the second time this month the bank has nudged the mini-band lower, and represents a 0.09 percent decline from the previous mini-band.
